unit: one manually inventoried atomic claim against one complete frozen evidence packet

candidate_outputs.CANDIDATE_SUPPORTED: Finite support score at or above that candidate's development-frozen threshold.
candidate_outputs.WITHHOLD: Finite support score below threshold, or any invalid/incomplete/overflow/resource failure. WITHHOLD does not say whether the claim is contradicted or merely unproved.

evidence_ids_mean: Material supplied to the checker, not model-verified proof.
input_requirements: all frozen evidence items for that case in frozen order
no answer-key, expected-label, group or scoring fields
complete formatted tokenizer count at or below 1024
no truncation and exactly one passage computation
whole_summary_aggregation: Only a non-empty, complete inventory in which every claim is CANDIDATE_SUPPORTED yields CANDIDATE_SUPPORTED. Any withheld, invalid, missing or duplicated claim yields WITHHOLD.
known_limitations: The candidates cannot discover a material summary claim omitted from the manual inventory.
A high score cannot prove that the supplied evidence packet was complete.
A low score cannot distinguish contradiction from missing evidence.
A passage examined is not automatically a passage that supports the full claim.
This factual signal is separate from Summary House Style V04 and editorial acceptance.
